name: cache-keeper
description: Band above the prompt: prompt-cache countdown, context size, rate limits, session cost, cold-cache cost, one-click handoff, and a cost profile per plan that can steer subagent models, effort and compaction.

ttlMinutes.title: Cache TTL (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: Used until the TTL is detected from a warm or cold turn. /cache-ttl overrides it.

warnTokens.title: Context warning (tokens)
warnTokens.description: Context size where quality may start degrading. Turns yellow here, red at twice this.

inputUsdPerMtok.title: Input price (USD per million tokens)
inputUsdPerMtok.description: Base input price for the cold-cache estimate. Replaced by the engine's own rate once it reports one.

profile.title: Cost profile
profile.description: Plan whose routing defaults apply. auto reads the plan from the rate limits and ~/.claude.json.

enforce.title: Enforce profile
enforce.description: Off: the band only shows the profile. On: rewrite subagent model and effort, cap Fable, set main effort, veto early auto-compaction.

showProfile.title: Show profile line
showProfile.description: Second band line with the profile, live main model and effort, Fable count and compaction window.

mainEffort.title: Main effort
mainEffort.description: Overrides the profile's main-loop effort. The main model is never changed: that would re-cache the whole prefix.

fablePerSession.title: Fable subagents per session
fablePerSession.description: Fable escalations allowed before they are downgraded. -1 uses the profile's.

compactRoomTokens.title: Compaction room (tokens)
compactRoomTokens.description: Working room over the measured floor before the window. 0 uses the profile's.
